nested.name: mcp__t3_code__device_close
nested.description: Remove a device from this thread's Device panel. Pass shutdown=true to also power the simulator or emulator off.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__device_list
nested.description: List iOS Simulators and Android Emulators on this environment's device hosts, which platforms each host can run, and which devices are already open in this thread's Device panel. Call this before device_open when you do not know a device id.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__device_open
nested.description: Open a simulator or emulator for this thread: boots it if needed, starts its live stream, and shows it in the user's Device panel so they can watch. Returns the agent-device CLI invocation pinned to the device; drive the device with that CLI afterwards.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__device_screenshot
nested.description: Capture the current screen of an open device as a PNG image. Use it to see what the user sees; for taps and text use the agent-device CLI.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__link_pull_request
nested.description: Register every pull request you open for this thread, including each layer of a stack, right after creating it. Links a pull request to this thread so T3 Code tracks it, shows its status beside the thread, and settles the thread when it merges. Pass the URL, or repository plus number. Linking an already-linked pull request succeeds with alreadyLinked=true.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__list_thread_pull_requests
nested.description: List the pull requests linked to this thread with their last known host state, and how they chain into stacks (bottom to top). Register every pull request you open for this thread, including each layer of a stack, right after creating it.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_click
nested.description: Click exactly one target in the tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted. Prefer a Playwright locator; selector accepts legacy CSS; x and y must be supplied together.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_evaluate
nested.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted. Returns {value} with a serializable result up to 64 KB; the expression may mutate page state.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_navigate
nested.description: Navigate a collaborative browser tab. Pass tabId to target a specific tab, plus {url:'https://t3.chat'} for a website or {target:{kind:'environment-port',port:5173}} for a dev server. Exactly one of url or target is required.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_open
nested.description: Initialize a collaborative browser tab and open its thread-bound inline preview by default. Set open=false for background-only automation. Pass tabId to reuse a specific existing tab, set reuseExistingTab=false to create another tab, or omit both to use this agent session's current tab.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_press
nested.description: Press one keyboard key in the tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted. Examples: {key:'Enter'}, {key:'Escape'}, or {key:'a',modifiers:['Meta']}.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_recording_start
nested.description: Start recording the collaborative browser tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_recording_stop
nested.description: Stop recording the collaborative browser tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted, and transfer the compressed recording once (up to 50 MiB) to an evidence file readable in this agent's environment. Returns its environment-local path after transfer succeeds.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_resize
nested.description: Resize a collaborative browser tab, optionally selected by tabId. Use {mode:'fill'}, {mode:'freeform',width:1024,height:768}, or {mode:'preset',preset:'iphone-12-pro',orientation:'portrait'}. This changes CSS layout breakpoints without changing the desktop browser user agent.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_scroll
nested.description: Scroll the tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted. Positive deltaY scrolls down and positive deltaX scrolls right; a locator/selector targets a container.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_set_appearance
nested.description: Emulate prefers-color-scheme in a collaborative browser tab, optionally selected by tabId. Use {colorScheme:'dark'} or {colorScheme:'light'} to preview the page in that appearance, and {colorScheme:'system'} to clear the override and follow the OS appearance.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_snapshot
nested.description: Inspect a page before interacting. Pass tabId to inspect a specific tab; omit it to use this agent session's current tab. Returns page state, semantic elements, diagnostics, action history, and a PNG screenshot. The text is capped near 20 KB and lists what it omitted; use preview_evaluate to read more. Set includeImage=false for text-only output with the same page metadata. Set save=true to also write the PNG to disk and get screenshotPath back; with includeImage=false, save=true returns only the url and screenshotPath. Embed that path in your reply as ![alt](screenshotPath) so the user sees it. This is the only way to show the user a screenshot; the image in the tool result is not saved anywhere.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_status
nested.description: Report whether a collaborative browser tab is automation-capable, including its URL, title, visibility, loading state, viewport mode, and measured CSS-pixel size. Pass tabId to inspect a specific tab; omit it to use this agent session's current tab.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_type
nested.description: Insert literal text into one input in the tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted. Prefer a Playwright locator; set clear=true to replace existing text.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__preview_wait_for
nested.description: Wait in the tab selected by tabId, or this agent session's current tab when omitted, until all supplied locator, selector, text, and URL conditions match.

nested.name: mcp__t3_code__unlink_pull_request
nested.description: Remove a pull request link from this thread, for example after closing a pull request you opened by mistake. Pass the URL, or repository plus number. Unlinking a pull request that is not linked succeeds with wasLinked=false.
